prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for sunny home and lifestyle demonstration. Instruments: nylon guitar, brushed percussion, upright bass. 106 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a clipped falling fifth answered by two repeated notes. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: A groovy and upbeat funk track featuring a prominent bassline, tight drums, and a catchy electric guitar melody. It has a retro feel with a modern production.
description.zh: 一首律动感十足、欢快的放克音乐，以突出的贝斯线、紧凑的鼓点和抓耳的电吉他旋律为特色。它带有复古气息和现代制作感。
